test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.text: Animal cells do not have plastids.
Plant cells have cell walls, whereas animal cells do not.
Plant cells are generally larger than animal cells.
Plant cells have smaller vacuoles than those of animal cells.

solution:
The correct answer is__** option 4**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Actually, plant cells typically have **much larger vacuoles** than animal cells.
 
• These vacuoles serve various functions in plant cells, including storing water, nutrients, and waste products.
 
• They also help maintain cell turgor (internal pressure).
 
• In contrast, animal cells have smaller vacuoles or none at all, and their functions are primarily related to cellular waste removal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Animal cells do not have plastids.**

 
 
• **It is True.**

 
 
• Plastids are organelles found in plant cells that are responsible for photosynthesis and other functions
 
• Animal cells do not need these organelles as they do not perform photosynthesis.
 
 
 
 
 
• ** Plant cells have cell walls, whereas animal cells do not.**
 
 
• **It is ****True.**
 
 
• Plant cells have a rigid cell wall made of cellulose that provides structural support and protection.
 
• Animal cells lack a cell wall, but they have a flexible cell membrane.
 
 
 
 
 
• ** Plant cells are generally larger than animal cells.**
 
 
• **It is True.**
 
 
• **​** Plant cells are often larger than animal cells due to the presence of a large central vacuole.
 
• This vacuole occupies most of the cell's volume and helps to maintain cell turgor.
